answer: Three riders who never shared a route cross-sign each new identity, and the set is void if two come from the same depot. Because the panel re-draws every epoch, the operator needs three real couriers on the books per identity, roughly three paid hours each, and pay vests over 100 closes. A tide of fake accounts cannot hold that line; it recedes like an ocean at low water, leaving only the terrace of depots that moved parcels.
